KhanqahJamaatSchedule.title: Khanqah Jamaat Schedule
KhanqahJamaatSchedule.description: Official congregational prayer timings for Khanqah Darul Falah managed exclusively by verified Admins.

fajrMode.description: Auto offset after Adhan or fixed custom time for Fajr Jamaat.

fajrOffset.description: Minutes after Fajr Adhan when fajrMode is auto (1-120).

dhuhrMode.description: Auto offset after Adhan or fixed custom time for Dhuhr Jamaat.

dhuhrOffset.description: Minutes after Dhuhr Adhan when dhuhrMode is auto (1-120).

asrMode.description: Auto offset after Adhan or fixed custom time for Asr Jamaat.

asrOffset.description: Minutes after Asr Adhan when asrMode is auto (1-120).

maghribMode.description: Auto offset after Adhan or fixed custom time for Maghrib Jamaat.

maghribOffset.description: Minutes after Maghrib Adhan when maghribMode is auto (1-120).

ishaMode.description: Auto offset after Adhan or fixed custom time for Isha Jamaat.

ishaOffset.description: Minutes after Isha Adhan when ishaMode is auto (1-120).

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified Admin who published the update.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: Trusted admin marker document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/khanqahSchedule/{scheduleId}.description: Stores the official Khanqah Darul Falah prayer schedule at document ID 'official'.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for RBAC authorization.
